npcs.name: Pip
npcs.personality: Playful, curious tiny dragon who turns scary Python errors into friendly clues and gives helpful hints.
npcs.catchphrase: One line at a time, Code-Tamer. We've got this!

npcs.name: Elder Ada
npcs.personality: Kind, wise storyteller who remembers when Pyria was in full 3D color and guides you from Realm to Realm.
npcs.catchphrase: Every rescued dragon brings another Bit of our world back to life.

npcs.name: Bram the Tinkerer
npcs.personality: Loud, cheerful dwarf builder who only takes Python commands to make gear and upgrades with Byte Shards.
npcs.catchphrase: No buttons in my shop, kid! Type the command and watch the sparks fly!

npcs.name: Lord Null
npcs.personality: Goofy, glitchy villain who wants to turn Pyria into an empty void of None and broken code.
npcs.catchphrase: Soon all of Pyria will return None! Mwahahaha!
